completeness.why: All five provider functions now only map their own account data (institution, bank key, account id, insert fields) and call linkBankSyncAccount, which owns upgrade-or-insert, the missing-account throw, transfer payee, initial sync, handleSyncResponse and the sync-event; the preserved inconsistencies are explicit arguments (accountFields with/without mask, fileId only for Pluggy.ai, syncEventTables for Akahu).

interface.why: Parameters map to the real variation and the inconsistencies are explicit, though syncEventTables as a free string[] and an open accountFields object are slightly looser than named options.
